digest.component_or_area: Ruff linter configuration and timezone semantics
propositions: Enable Ruff ASYNC and DTZ rule families in pyproject.toml linter selection after resolving all active diagnostics in src/rebar and tests/

Establish explicit UTC timezone semantics for timestamp validation: epoch seconds use datetime.fromtimestamp(created, tz=datetime.timezone.utc); timezone-naive persisted strings use datetime.strptime().replace(tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
Create tests/unit/test_ruff_ratchet.py to enforce ASYNC/DTZ selection, prohibit datetime.UTC token in src/rebar, and assert absence of Ruff S selector and .semgrep configuration
Prove timestamp clustering produces identical UTC hour keys across multiple TZ environment settings using time.tzset() on POSIX/macOS platforms
Preserve security-pin cadence as host-local calendar date obtained via datetime.now(tz=datetime.timezone.utc).astimezone().date() to satisfy DTZ005 compliance
Resolve drift-introduced ASYNC and DTZ violations in test_jira_onboard.py, test_review_bot.py, and test_validate_idea_exemptions.py before landing ratchet
